title: UiLayoutSuggestion
description: ui.layout-suggestion@1: OpenVibe.AI's answer to ui.layout.suggest. ok true carries the layout, already checked by openvibe-sdk/ui-layout against the catalog sent with the request, and a one-sentence summary of what changed plus the model's reasons. ok false is an honest refusal: no layout, one sentence saying what it could not do, and the validator's reasons in plain words (for example "Stop has to stay visible."). A receipt names the model that answered, with the run and the route. The suggestion is previewed, never applied silently; Network or the product stores it only after the person accepts it.

layout.description: The validated layout when ok is true; null when it is false.

summary.description: One sentence saying what changed, or what could not be done.

reasons.description: Why this arrangement, or the validator's reasons for refusing one.

receipt.description: Which model answered: the same receipt every AI run carries, at the task's own shape.
